facts.statement: A hand is the set of cards a player holds.
facts.sourceSentence: Hand: The cards each player holds.

facts.statement: Each player begins the game with 3 cards in hand.
facts.sourceSentence: Each starts with 3 and ends the game with 10.

facts.statement: Each player ends the game with 10 cards in hand.
facts.sourceSentence: Each starts with 3 and ends the game with 10.

facts.statement: A set is two or more cards whose numbers match.
An example of a valid set is three cards of the number 5.
A run is three or more cards in numeric order.
An example of a valid run is 5, 6, 7.

facts.sourceSentence: There are numbers ranging from 1-7 in 4 colors, with 4 copies of each card.
